<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def green_pos(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    for r in range(38,46):
        for c in range(8,16):
            if a[r][c]=='N': return ((r-38)//2,(c-8)//2)
def done(): return bool(last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
# set red top, blue bottom
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
print('cfg', 'red top, blue bottom', 'green', green_pos(current_frame))
# clean sweep: from current green, visit all 9 via BFS tracking actual pos
from collections import deque
cur = green_pos(current_frame)
seen={cur}
if done(): print('DONE at start')
else:
    q=deque([(cur,[])])
    moves={'U':('UP',-1,0),'D':('DOWN',1,0),'L':('LEFT',0,-1),'R':('RIGHT',0,1)}
    found=None
    while q and not found:
        pos,path=q.popleft()
        # move to each neighbor
        for m,(act,dr,dc) in moves.items():
            np_=(pos[0]+dr,pos[1]+dc)
            if 0<=np_[0]<3 and 0<=np_[1]<3 and np_ not in seen:
                seen.add(np_)
                action([act])
                actual=green_pos(current_frame)
                print('moved',act,'target',np_,'actual',actual,'done',done())
                if done(): found=actual; break
                q.append((actual,path+[act]))
    print('FOUND' if found else 'no completion in red-top/blue-bottom sweep','seen',len(seen))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
